handovers.task: Per-machine screensaver MSI fix proposal for review (ATLAS-MSI-CL-20261104-01)
handovers.outcome: Owner approved the administrator prompt and an unsigned file in System32. Review branch makes the MSI per-machine: one x64 SCR in System32, no SysWOW64 copy, documents in Program Files, 3 Start Menu items. Install stops if an older per-user copy exists. Updater leaves the MSI because it cannot replace a per-machine install; Windows automatic updates need a redesign before signing. Not a release; no PR opened.
